dogecoin.text:
.@Gemini -  the cryptocurrency exchange founded by @tyler and @cameron - is going all in on #dogecoin.

As of today, you can now earn interest on your dogecoin.

Here's how it works: https://t.co/epM1eeL3FZ

With #bitcoin, wash sale rules don’t apply, meaning that you can sell your BTC and buy it right back vs. waiting 30 days to buy back a stock. This nuance in the tax code is absolutely huge for BTC holders in the US. More on tax-loss harvesting: https://t.co/hqnZ57skOZ
